papers.title: Surface chemistry of Ti6Al4V components fabricated using selective laser melting for biomedical applications
papers.abstract: Selective laser melting (SLM) has previously been shown to be a viable method for fabricating biomedical implants; however, the surface chemistry of SLM fabricated parts is poorly understood. In this study, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was used to determine the surface chemistries of (a) SLM as-fabricated (SLM-AF) Ti6Al4V and (b) SLM fabricated and mechanically polished (SLM-MP) Ti6Al4V samples and compared with (c) traditionally manufactured (forged) and mechanically polished Ti6Al4V samples. The SLM-AF surface was observed to be porous with an average surface roughness (Ra) of 17.6±3.7μm. The surface chemistry of the SLM-AF was significantly different to the FGD-MP surface with respect to elemental distribution and their existence on the outermost surface. Sintered particles on the SLM-AF surface were observed to affect depth profiling of the sample due to a shadowing effect during argon ion sputtering. Surface heterogeneity was observed for all three surfaces; however, vanadium was witnessed only on the mechanically polished (SLM-MP and FGD-MP) surfaces. The direct and indirect 3T3 cell cytotoxicity studies revealed that the cells were viable on the SLM fabricated Ti6Al4V parts. The varied surface chemistry of the SLM-AF and SLM-MP did not influence the cell behaviour.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM制备的Ti6Al4V表面化学性质与细胞相容性。
summary_zh.method: 使用XPS分析表面化学，并通过直接/间接细胞毒性实验评估生物相容性。
summary_zh.result: 不同表面处理样品的表面化学有差异，但均无细胞毒性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过3T3细胞毒性实验验证生物相容性。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the surface chemistry of Ti6Al4V parts fabricated by selective laser melting for biomedical applications, which is poorly understood. (paraphrased)
summary_en.method: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was used to characterize the surface chemistry of as-fabricated and mechanically polished SLM Ti6Al4V, and direct and indirect 3T3 cell cytotoxicity assays were performed.
summary_en.result: The as-fabricated SLM surface showed different elemental distribution and surface roughness compared to polished surfaces, but all surfaces supported cell viability without cytotoxicity.
summary_en.validation: In vitro 3T3 fibroblast cytotoxicity tests (direct and indirect) validated biocompatibility.

papers.title: Characterisation and milling time optimisation of nanocrystalline aluminium powder for selective laser melting
papers.abstract: The aim of this study is to investigate the properties of high-energy ball-milled nanocrystalline aluminium powders and to determine the optimum milling time required to produce an advanced aluminium powder for selective laser melting (SLM). Previous research has indicated that powders suitable for SLM include milled nanocrystalline aluminium powders with an average grain size of 60 nm and good flowability (Carr index less than 15 %). This study employs advanced nanometrology methods and analytical techniques to investigate the powder morphology, phase identification, average grain size and flowability of ball-milled powders. Stearic acid is used to prevent excessive cold welding of the ball-milled powder and to reduce abrasion of the grinding bowl and balls. The results indicate that, whilst the average particle size achieves a steady state after 14 h of milling, the grain size continues to decrease as the milling time progressed (e.g. the transmission electron microscopy measured average grain size is 56 nm after 20 h of milling compared to 75 nm for 14 h of milling). The aluminium powders milled for 16 and 20 h exhibit good flow behaviour, achieving a Carr index of 13.5 and 15.8 %, respectively. This study shows that advanced nanocrystalline aluminium powders suitable for SLM require ball milling for between 16 and 20 h, with 18 h being the optimum milling time.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝粉的球磨工艺，与生物医学植入物或AM生物材料无关。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no porous structure, no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化纳米晶铝粉球磨时间以获得适合SLM的粉末。
summary_zh.method: 通过20小时球磨并添加硬脂酸制备铝粉，表征形貌、晶粒尺寸和流动性。
summary_zh.result: 18小时为最佳球磨时间，可获得晶粒56 nm且流动性好的粉末。
summary_zh.validation: 采用TEM、SEM和卡尔指数实测验证。

summary_en.motivation: Optimize ball milling time for nanocrystalline aluminum powder to achieve suitable properties for selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Characterization of morphology, grain size, and flowability of ball-milled aluminum powder with stearic acid over 20 hours.
summary_en.result: 16-20 hours milling yields nanocrystalline powders with grain size ~56 nm and good flowability (Carr index ~13.5-15.8%).
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via TEM, SEM, and Carr index measurements.

papers.title: Indirect Fabrication of Lattice Metals with Thin Sections Using Centrifugal Casting
papers.abstract: One of the typical methods to manufacture 3D lattice metals is the direct-metal additive manufacturing (AM) process such as Selective Laser Melting (SLM) and Electron Beam Melting (EBM). In spite of its potential processing capability, the direct AM method has several disadvantages such as high cost, poor surface finish of final products, limitation in material selection, high thermal stress, and anisotropic properties of parts. We propose a cost-effective method to manufacture 3D lattice metals. The objective of this study is to provide a detailed protocol on fabrication of 3D lattice metals having a complex shape and a thin wall thickness; e.g., octet truss made of Al and Cu alloys having a unit cell length of 5 mm and a cell wall thickness of 0.5 mm. An overall experimental procedure is divided into eight sections: (a) 3D printing of sacrificial patterns (b) melt-out of support materials (c) removal of residue of support materials (d) pattern assembly (e) investment (f) burn-out of sacrificial patterns (g) centrifugal casting (h) post-processing for final products. The suggested indirect AM technique provides the potential to manufacture ultra-lightweight lattice metals; e.g., lattice structures with Al alloys. It appears that the process parameters should be properly controlled depending on materials and lattice geometry, observing the final products of octet truss metals by the indirect AM technique.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文涉及晶格金属制造，但未涉及LPBF、机械测试或应力屏蔽评估，与生物医学植入物方向不相关。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static/fatigue), no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no surface morphology or osseointegration analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出低成本的间接铸造方法制备复杂薄壁晶格金属。
summary_zh.method: 通过3D打印牺牲模、熔模铸造和离心铸造制备铝铜晶格。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备了单元尺寸5mm、壁厚0.5mm的八面体桁架结构。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过观察最终产品验证工艺可行性。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a cost-effective indirect fabrication method for complex thin-walled lattice metals that overcomes limitations of direct metal additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: An indirect approach combining 3D-printed sacrificial patterns, investment casting, and centrifugal casting to produce octet truss lattices from Al and Cu alloys.
summary_en.result: Lattice structures with 5 mm unit cells and 0.5 mm wall thickness were successfully cast, demonstrating feasibility for lightweight metals.
summary_en.validation: Process validation was limited to visual inspection of final products without quantitative mechanical testing.
